nodes.name: Act 1 - Silenus Bluffs
nodes.summary: Exile washes up on the Twilight Strand, reaches Lioneye's Watch, defeats Brutus in Axiom Prison and Merveil in her lair; monster levels 1-13.

nodes.name: Act 2 - Phrecia
nodes.summary: Forest Encampment act: the exile deals with three bandit lords, follows Piety's Blackguards, and ends the act by killing the Vaal Oversoul; levels 13-23.

nodes.name: Act 3 - Sarn
nodes.summary: The ruined Eternal capital Sarn, infested with undead and Blackguards; Dominus and Piety experiment with virtue gems; ends with Dominus in the Sceptre of God; levels 23-33.

nodes.name: Act 4 - Highgate
nodes.summary: Maraketh-held Highgate mining town; with Lady Dialla's help the exile enters the Beast and kills Malachai; levels 33-40.

nodes.name: Act 5 - Oriath
nodes.summary: The Fall of Oriath: slave rebellion against the Templars, Avarius and Innocence fall, Utula summons Kitava; levels 41-45.

nodes.name: Marauder (Exile class)
nodes.summary: Karui-descended Exile class. Dominus's boss line to the Marauder: "I exiled an animal. Now you almost resemble a man, Karui."; General Gravicius: "You've forgotten your place, Karui slave!" Specific crime not given in the sources read.

nodes.name: Witch (Exile class)
nodes.summary: Exile class. Dominus: "You'd bite the master that called you here, Witch?"; Gravicius: "whore of nightmare"; Piety addresses the Witch as 'sister' in Act 4. A developer-interview reason for the Witch's exile (PC Gamer) could NOT be re-verified in this check and has been removed.

nodes.name: Ranger (Exile class)
nodes.summary: Exile class (female). Dominus: "It is woman's purpose to tempt and try the will of man."; Gravicius: "little girl". Specific crime not documented in the sources read.

nodes.name: Duelist (Exile class)
nodes.summary: Exile class. Dominus: "Welcome to the greatest of arenas, Duelist. God is watching."; Gravicius: "Your soul was lost long ago!" Specific crime not documented in the sources read.

nodes.name: Shadow (Exile class)
nodes.summary: Exile class. Dominus: "I've dealt with far darker shadows than you, exile."; Gravicius: "You're not the only one who wields death as a weapon, boy!" Specific crime not documented in the sources read.

nodes.name: Templar (Exile class)
nodes.summary: Exile class belonging to the Templar faith: Dominus addresses the Templar as "my brother" ("Exile has tested you, my brother"); Gravicius: "You're god's greatest disappointment." Specific crime not documented in the sources read.

nodes.name: Scion (Exile class)
nodes.summary: Seventh Exile class, available only after reaching Act 3 (unlock details not re-verified). Dominus: "I offered you the gift of exile and you used it to reinvent yourself." No further heritage lore verified.

nodes.name: Sentencing of the Exiles by Oriath
nodes.summary: Criminals of Oriath are sentenced by the Templar Church for Sins (Letters of Exile lists charges, e.g. 1597-1599 IC) and shipped to Wraeclast by Dominus's Blackguards.

sources.locator: Format section: "You are hereby Exiled to Wraeclast..."

nodes.name: Exiles Dumped onto the Twilight Strand
nodes.summary: The Exile is among about two dozen exiles dumped into the water off a ship by Dominus's Blackguards and washes up on the Twilight Strand; a Dying Exile says smoke was seen at ruins up the beach (the wiki does not describe a shipwreck as such).

sources.locator: Walkthrough: Dying Exile quote "We're all that made it? They dumped... two dozen of us exiles off that ship."
Walkthrough: Dying Exile quote "We're all that made it? They dumped... two dozen of us exiles off that ship."

nodes.name: Enemy at the Gate
nodes.summary: The Exile kills Hillock at the end of the Twilight Strand, opening Lioneye's Watch; Tarkleigh rewards them.

nodes.name: Mercy Mission
nodes.summary: Nessa asks for a ship's Medicine Chest; Bestel says it lies on the Tidal Island where his Merry Gull ran aground; Hailrake holds it. (Optional quest.)

nodes.name: A Dirty Job
nodes.summary: Tarkleigh sends the Exile to clear the Fetid Pool of the necromancer Kadavrus the Defiler who raises the dead rhoa. (Optional quest.)

nodes.name: Breaking Some Eggs
nodes.summary: The Exile finds three Karui glyph shells in rhoa nests and fits them to the glyph wall in the Mud Flats to drain the Submerged Passage.

nodes.name: The Dweller of the Deep
nodes.summary: Tarkleigh asks the Exile to kill a giant crab nesting in the Flooded Depths. (Optional quest.)

nodes.name: The Caged Brute
nodes.summary: The Exile kills Brutus, Warden of Axiom Prison, in the Warden's Chambers, opening the way through the Prison.

sources.locator: Walkthrough; Nessa dialogue on Brutus myth
Walkthrough; Nessa dialogue on Brutus myth

nodes.name: The Marooned Mariner
nodes.summary: Captain Fairgraves in the Ship Graveyard sends the Exile for the Allflame; he then tries to kindle it with the Exile's life, and is killed (the Exile later meets his spirit in Act 3). (Optional quest.)

nodes.name: The Way Forward (Thaumetic Seal)
nodes.summary: Optional quest given by Tarkleigh after entering the Ledge; spans Acts 1-2. Piety (who had met the Exile in the Warden's Chambers) raises Shavronne's old barricade at Prisoner's Gate; Silk mentions a stone carving by the south pass; in the Western Forest the Exile kills Captain Arteri for the Thaumetic Emblem to open the Thaumetic Seal, and is rewarded by Bestel.

chronology.relative: Given in Act 1 (after the Ledge), completed in Act 2 Western Forest

nodes.name: The Siren's Cadence
nodes.summary: The Exile kills Merveil, the Siren, in her lair, freeing the coast and the way to the Southern Forest of Act 2.

nodes.name: Arrival at the Forest Encampment
nodes.summary: After Merveil the Exile enters the Southern Forest and the Forest Encampment, a small village (Helena calls it 'that Azmeri village by the river') of Greust, Silk, Yeena and Eramir, extorted by bandit lords.

nodes.name: Deal with the Bandits
nodes.summary: Three bandit lords (Alira, Oak, Kraityn) terrorize the encampment; the Exile kills all three for a skill point, or kills two and sides with one for a permanent bonus.

nodes.name: Intruders in Black
nodes.summary: Greust sends the Exile after the 'warriors in black' (Blackguards) near the Chamber of Sins; the Exile kills Fidelitas, rescues Helena and takes the Baleful Gem from the Strange Device; Helena joins the encampment.

nodes.name: Sharp and Cruel
nodes.summary: Silk asks for his spear lodged in the eye of the Weaver; the Exile kills the Weaver and takes Maligaro's Spike.

nodes.name: The Great White Beast
nodes.summary: Yeena asks the Exile to end the suffering of a tortured great white beast in the Old Fields' Den. (Optional quest.)

nodes.name: Through Sacred Ground
nodes.summary: Yeena sends the Exile to the Crypt in Fellshrine for the Golden Hand of the 'good man' (Archbishop Geofri). (Optional quest.)

nodes.name: The Root of the Problem
nodes.summary: Helena has the Exile poison the great tree Lorrata in the Wetlands with Maligaro's Spike and the Baleful Gem, to open the Vaal ruins before Piety can.

nodes.name: Shadow of the Vaal
nodes.summary: Entering the Vaal Ruins the Exile's touching the Ancient Seal releases a darkness; the Exile climbs the Ancient Pyramid, uses The Apex on the Dark Altar and kills the Vaal Oversoul.

nodes.name: Arrival at Sarn
nodes.summary: The Exile enters the ruined Eternal capital Sarn, overrun by undead, and reaches the Sarn Encampment (Hargan, Clarissa, Maramoa, Grigor).

nodes.name: Lost in Love
nodes.summary: The Exile rescues Clarissa from Blackguards and retrieves Tolman's bracelet from the Crematorium where Piety tortured him to death; Piety flees.

nodes.name: Victario's Secrets
nodes.summary: Hargan sends the Exile to the Sewers to find three platinum busts (Sentari, Titucius, Lioneye) that Victario stole from Chitus. (Optional quest.)

nodes.name: The Gemling Queen
nodes.summary: Grigor sends the Exile to Solaris Temple Level 2, where Lady Dialla the Gemling Queen still lives.

nodes.name: The Ribbon Spool
nodes.summary: Dialla asks for her stolen Ribbon Spool from the Battlefront, held by the Ebony Legion. (Optional quest.)

nodes.name: Fiery Dust
nodes.summary: Dialla has the Exile fetch Thaumetic Sulphite from the Docks so she can brew Infernal Talc to burn through the Undying Blockade in the Sewers.

nodes.name: Sever the Right Hand
nodes.summary: Maramoa tasks the Exile to kill General Gravicius in the Ebony Barracks across the river.

nodes.name: Piety's Pets
nodes.summary: Grigor sends the Exile to kill Piety in her Lunaris Temple laboratory, where she makes miscreations; she drops the Tower Key (later revealed Malachai saved her).

nodes.name: A Swig of Hope
nodes.summary: If Fairgraves died in Act 1, his spirit in the Docks asks for a decanter and fruit. (Optional quest.)

nodes.name: A Fixture of Fate
nodes.summary: Siosa, a spectral presence in the Library, asks the Exile to find four Vaalish Golden Pages hidden by Icius Perandus in the Archives (behind a loose candle); he rewards gem access.

nodes.name: The Sceptre of God
nodes.summary: With Piety's Tower Key the Exile climbs the Sceptre of God and kills High Templar Dominus; Lady Dialla appears and opens the way to Act 4.

nodes.name: Arrival at Highgate
nodes.summary: Dialla meets the Exile at the Aqueduct and in Highgate asks them to destroy the Beast sealed in the mountain; Oyun and the Maraketh hold Highgate.

nodes.name: Breaking the Seal
nodes.summary: The Exile kills Voll, the Brittle Emperor in the Dried Lake, takes Deshret's Banner and breaks Deshret's Seal on the Mines.

nodes.name: An Indomitable Spirit
nodes.summary: Tasuni asks the Exile to free the spirit of Sekhema Deshret trapped in the Mines Level 2. (Optional quest.)

nodes.name: The King of Fury
nodes.summary: The Exile kills King Kaom in Kaom's Stronghold and brings the Eye of Fury to Dialla.

nodes.name: The King of Desire
nodes.summary: The Exile kills Daresso, King of Swords, in the Grand Arena and brings the Eye of Desire to Dialla.

nodes.name: Activation of the Rapture Device
nodes.summary: With the two Eyes the Rapture Device in the Crystal Veins is powered (Dialla's life force) and drills into the Belly of the Beast.

nodes.name: Corpus Malachus
nodes.summary: Piety, defeated as an Abomination, requires three of Malachai's organs from his Godless Three (Maligaro, Shavronne, Doedre) to open the Black Core.

sources.locator: Walkthrough; Piety page Godless Three dialogue
Walkthrough; Piety page Godless Three dialogue

nodes.name: The Eternal Nightmare: Malachai defeated
nodes.summary: The Exile kills Malachai, The Nightmare, in the Black Core; Piety dies impaled by him in the fight; the Beast dies, ending Act 4.

nodes.name: Return to Oriath
nodes.summary: The Exile climbs the Ascent of Mt. Veruso, activates the Resonator and arrives in Oriath's Slave Pens; kills Overseer Krow to reach the rebel camp at Overseer's Tower where Lani rewards them.

nodes.name: The Key to Freedom
nodes.summary: Utula demands Justicar Casticus's faithful eyes; the Exile kills Casticus in the Control Blocks and takes the Eyes of Zeal to enter the Templar Courts.

nodes.name: In Service to Science
nodes.summary: Vilenta asks the Exile to recover her Miasmeter from Piety's laboratory. (Optional quest.)

nodes.name: Death to Purity
nodes.summary: The Exile kills High Templar Avarius, vessel of the god Innocence, in the Chamber of Innocence; Sin appears.

nodes.name: The King's Feast
nodes.summary: Bannon asks the Exile to kill Utula to stop the King's Feast; Utula dies but completes the ritual that summons Kitava.

nodes.name: Kitava's Torments
nodes.summary: Lani sends the Exile to the Reliquary for three Karui artefacts (Hinekora's Hair, Tukohama's Tooth, Valako's Jaw) taken by the Templars from Ngamakanui. (Optional quest.)

nodes.name: The Ravenous God
nodes.summary: Kitava awakens and devours Oriath; the Exile uses the Sign of Purity on the Cathedral Rooftop, but Kitava destroys it; Sin saves the Exile and Captain Lilly Roth ferries survivors back to Wraeclast, beginning Part II.

nodes.name: Hillock
nodes.summary: First boss: an undead exile (Hillock of Slaugh) with a sword in his chest guarding the end of the Twilight Strand; killed in Enemy at the Gate.

nodes.name: Tarkleigh
nodes.summary: Veteran exile and smuggler at Lioneye's Watch; weapon and armour vendor who gives out quests and skill gems; mentions Dominus took the exiles' history.

sources.locator: Enemy at the Gate quest dialogue
Enemy at the Gate quest dialogue

nodes.name: Nessa
nodes.summary: Healer and vendor at Lioneye's Watch, taught Brutus's tale in Theopolis schools; gives Mercy Mission, Siren's Cadence.

sources.locator: NPCs; Mercy Mission, Caged Brute dialogue

nodes.name: Bestel
nodes.summary: Sailor-poet at Lioneye's Watch whose ship the Merry Gull ran aground; his epic and rewards follow Act 1 quests (also Act 6).

nodes.name: Kadavrus the Defiler
nodes.summary: Necromancer boss of the Fetid Pool who was raising the dead rhoa.

nodes.name: Hailrake
nodes.summary: Boss of the Tidal Island holding Doctor Opden's Medicine Chest.

nodes.name: Brutus, Lord Incarcerator
nodes.summary: Legendary warden of Axiom Prison who had himself transformed by thaumaturges (Shavronne of Umbra) into a hulking monster; killed in The Caged Brute.

nodes.name: Merveil, the Siren
nodes.summary: Former court beauty of Sarn who married the swordsman Daresso; the cursed Star of Wraeclast he gave her transformed her into a siren-like monster who bore monstrous children; Act 1 final boss (Cavern of Anger / Merveil's Lair).

nodes.name: Captain Fairgraves
nodes.summary: Marooned sea captain in the Ship Graveyard who found the Allflame, tried to kindle it with the Exile's life and was killed; reappears as an in-between spirit at the Act 3 Docks.

nodes.name: Captain Arteri
nodes.summary: Boss on the Western Forest road carrying the Thaumetic Emblem for the Thaumetic Seal.

nodes.name: Dying Exile
nodes.summary: Wounded fellow exile on the beach who points the player toward smoke at ruins.

nodes.name: The Allflame
nodes.summary: A mythical flame in a silver lantern found by Fairgraves in a shattered Empire cathedral; it must be kindled with life.

nodes.name: Star of Wraeclast
nodes.summary: Cursed ruby necklace Daresso gave Merveil; it turned her into a monster.

nodes.name: The Twilight Strand
nodes.summary: Beach where exiles first wash ashore; ends at Lioneye's Watch.

nodes.name: Lioneye's Watch
nodes.summary: Act 1 town of exile survivors on the coast, named after General Marceus Lioneye; conquered by Kaom's Karui in the past.

nodes.name: Axiom Prison
nodes.summary: Ancient clifftop prison (no one remembers who built it) used by every power that ruled Wraeclast; its warden Brutus was mutated; Act 1 area from Lower Prison to Warden's Chambers.

nodes.name: Merveil's Lair
nodes.summary: Act 1 boss area at the end of the Cavern of Anger.

nodes.name: The Ship Graveyard
nodes.summary: Coastal wreck field where Fairgraves is marooned.

nodes.name: Exiles of Wraeclast
nodes.summary: Convicted Oriathans banished to Wraeclast; survive at Lioneye's Watch and later camps.

nodes.name: Eramir
nodes.summary: Scholar-like resident of the Forest Encampment who holds theories on the Vaal ruin and Apex; starts Deal with the Bandits.

nodes.name: Greust
nodes.summary: Forest Encampment weapon/armour vendor and hunter, hostile to Oriathans; gives Intruders in Black. (Helena calls the village Azmeri; Greust's own ethnicity is not stated in the sources read.)

nodes.name: Silk
nodes.summary: Forest Encampment hero-storyteller who lost his spear in the Weaver's eye; shares word of the stone seal near Prisoner's Gate.

nodes.name: Yeena
nodes.summary: Dream-seer vendor in the Forest Encampment who dreams of the Great White Beast, the Golden Hand and the shadow climbing the Vaal pyramid.

sources.locator: Yeena dialogue; Shadow of the Vaal
Yeena dialogue; Shadow of the Vaal

nodes.name: Helena
nodes.summary: Young Oriathan Ebony Legion woman rescued from the Chamber of Sins; joins the Forest Encampment and directs the Lorrata plan.

nodes.name: Alira
nodes.summary: Bandit lord of the Western Forest who uses corpse-detonation magic (Detonate Dead) and a cauldron; wears Alira's Amulet, one of three pieces of the Apex.

nodes.name: Oak
nodes.summary: Bandit lord of the Wetlands; preaches peace ('To spare the lives of many, you need take only one'), fights Alira's thralls; wears Oak's Amulet, one of three pieces of the Apex.

nodes.name: Kraityn
nodes.summary: Bandit lord of the Broken Bridge, exiled from Theopolis in 1598 IC for avarice, larceny, murder and more (Letters of Exile).

nodes.name: The Weaver
nodes.summary: Giant spider ('mother of all eight-legs') in the Weaver's Chambers, in whose eye Silk's spear (Maligaro's Spike) is lodged; killed by the Exile.

nodes.name: Fidelitas, the Mourning
nodes.summary: Former slave Raulo, Maligaro's loyal lover/servant, deformed into a monster that guards the Baleful Gem.

nodes.name: Lorrata
nodes.summary: Giant tree over the Vaal Ruins in the Wetlands, said to be the oldest tree in the area and planted by ancient Azmeri travellers (per Eramir); its roots held the Vaal doors shut until poisoned by the Exile with Maligaro's Spike and the Baleful Gem.

nodes.name: Archbishop Geofri the Abashed
nodes.summary: Archbishop Geofri the Abashed, a supporter of Voll's Purity Rebellion; boss of the Crypt (Fellshrine) tied to the Golden Hand of Through Sacred Ground.

nodes.name: Vaal Oversoul
nodes.summary: Shadowy Vaal spirit entity at the top of the Ancient Pyramid; final boss of Act 2; summoned by The Apex on the Dark Altar.

sources.locator: boss header; Shadow of the Vaal
boss header; Shadow of the Vaal

nodes.name: The Apex
nodes.summary: Capstone formed by combining the three bandit amulets, used on the Dark Altar to summon the Vaal Oversoul and lift the darkness.

nodes.name: Baleful Gem
nodes.summary: Maligaro's creation of calibric extantia guarded in the Chamber of Sins, used to poison Lorrata; Piety wanted it.

nodes.name: Maligaro's Spike
nodes.summary: Maligaro's device that injects calibric extantia into living flesh; stuck in the Weaver's eye as 'Silk's spear'.

nodes.name: The Forest Encampment
nodes.summary: Act 2 town in the Phrecian forest, a village of Greust, Silk, Yeena, Eramir.

nodes.name: Chamber of Sins
nodes.summary: Old Empire site where Maligaro worked; holds the Baleful Gem.

nodes.name: The Ancient Pyramid
nodes.summary: Vaal pyramid in the Caverns beyond the Vaal Ruins with the Dark Altar.

nodes.name: The Weaver's Chambers
nodes.summary: Spider-infested caves entered from the Western Forest.

nodes.name: Ebony Legion / Blackguards
nodes.summary: Dominus's Templar soldiers: Ebony Legion and Blackguards who enforce Oriath's rule and hunt in Wraeclast.

sources.locator: Lore: He also controls the Ebony Legion

nodes.name: Bandit Lords
nodes.summary: Three rival exile bandit leaders extorting the Forest Encampment.

nodes.name: Hargan
nodes.summary: Sarn Encampment weapon/armour vendor; fence who seeks Victario's busts for his 'return to Oriath' fund.

nodes.name: Clarissa
nodes.summary: Exile woman rescued from Blackguards in Sarn; becomes Sarn Encampment accessory vendor; lover of Tolman.

nodes.name: Tolman
nodes.summary: Clarissa's boyfriend, tortured to death by Piety in the Crematorium; reappears as a zombie in Act 8.

nodes.name: Maramoa
nodes.summary: Exile at the Sarn Encampment who gives Lost in Love and Sever the Right Hand; uses Karui terms (makoru, waikoama) so is probably Karui (inferred). The 'leader' role in the earlier draft was not supported.

nodes.name: Grigor
nodes.summary: Poet-scholar of the Sarn Encampment who knows the ode 'Of Jewels and Eternity', sends the Exile to the Gemling Queen, then after Piety and Dominus; Maramoa says to 'look upon Grigor to see what life entails under Piety's influence'.

nodes.name: Siosa
nodes.summary: Ghost in the Library, friend of Icius Perandus, gem vendor after A Fixture of Fate.

nodes.name: General Gravicius
nodes.summary: Dominus's assistant in artifact gathering, Ebony Barracks boss; fire-damage specialist.

nodes.name: Dominus, High Templar
nodes.summary: Highest-ranking High Templar of Oriath, controls Ebony Legion; pardoned Piety; final boss of Act 3 in the Sceptre of God; Ascendant form with blood magic.

nodes.name: Piety of Theopolis
nodes.summary: Former Vinia of Oriath, pardoned by Dominus; thaumaturge making miscreations in Sarn; saved by Malachai; becomes an Abomination in Act 4; eventually killed by Malachai.

sources.locator: Lore: Background and In Path of Exile
Lore: Background and In Path of Exile

nodes.name: Lady Dialla
nodes.summary: The Gemling Queen, Malachai's former lover and the Rapture Device's intended power source who chose not to sacrifice herself; guides the Exile in Acts 3-4.

nodes.name: Victario
nodes.summary: Sarn poet of the Purity Rebellion; stole three platinum busts; killed in the Cataclysm (comic Origins).

nodes.name: Icius Perandus
nodes.summary: Eternal Empire-era scholar and translator of Vaalish texts (name suggests the Perandus family, not verified); hid four Golden Pages in the Sarn Archives; friend of Siosa; also cited as author of the 'Chronicle of Atzoatl'.

nodes.name: Tower Key
nodes.summary: Royal key dropped by Piety allowing entry to the Sceptre of God.

nodes.name: Tolman's Bracelet
nodes.summary: Bracelet Clarissa made for Tolman.

nodes.name: The Sarn Encampment
nodes.summary: Act 3 town in Sarn.

nodes.name: The Lunaris Temple

nodes.name: Sekhema Deshret
nodes.summary: Ancient Maraketh Red Sekhema who sealed the Mines with the Beast and Kaom inside; fell to Voll, and her spirit was trapped in the Mines until freed.

nodes.name: Voll, Emperor of Purity
nodes.summary: High Templar Voll of Thebrus led the Purity Rebellion, became Emperor, spared Malachai, died in the Cataclysm; fought as the Brittle Emperor in the Dried Lake.

nodes.name: King Kaom
nodes.summary: King of the Karui (chieftain of the Ngamahu tribe) who invaded Lioneye's Watch for Voll's Purity Rebellion; later deceived by a vision from the 'black spirit', entered the Highgate mines, was corrupted by Malachai and sealed in with the Beast by Deshret; boss in Kaom's Stronghold (Act 4) holding the Eye of Fury.

nodes.name: Daresso, King of Swords
nodes.summary: Former slave gladiator and Sword King of the Grand Arena of Theopolis/Sarn, husband of Merveil; he abandoned her and sailed from Wraeclast seeking a cure, and later perished; boss of Daresso's Dream / Grand Arena in Act 4 who holds the Eye of Desire.

nodes.name: Malachai, The Nightmare
nodes.summary: Chitus's master thaumaturge, spared by Emperor Voll after promising 'the end to thaumaturgy'; built the Rapture Device, entered the Beast to take its power, and brought on the Cataclysm; final boss of Act 4 in the Black Core.

nodes.name: Inquisitor Maligaro
nodes.summary: Thaumaturge of Malachai's Godless Three; worked in the Chamber of Sins; burned by Voll; returns in Act 4 as the Inquisitor boss.

nodes.name: Shavronne of Umbra
nodes.summary: Thaumaturge of the Godless Three who created Brutus; Act 4 boss guarding Malachai's heart.

nodes.name: Doedre Darktongue
nodes.summary: Thaumaturge of the Godless Three burned at the stake by Voll; Act 4 boss in the Harvest, drops Malachai's Lungs.

nodes.name: Niko, Master of the Depths
nodes.summary: Act 4 master who introduces Delve content in Highgate.

nodes.name: The Godless Three
nodes.summary: Malachai's three most loyal servants: Maligaro, Shavronne, Doedre, guarding his organs.

nodes.name: The Rapture Device
nodes.summary: Malachai's machine in the Crystal Veins; powered by Eyes and Dialla; drills into the Beast.

nodes.name: The Eye of Desire
